claims.statement: Mike McCoole beat Tom Allen in the first of their two fights for the championship of America, winning by a wrangle.
claims.excerpt: winning the firs: battle by a wrangle

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in the second of their two fights for the championship of America, battering him badly.

fights.excerpt: winning the firs: battle by a wrangle
fights.notes: First of two bouts. The text says McCoole won it 'by a wrangle', so the result may be disputed.

notes: OCR prints McCoole as 'MeCvole'; the name is spelled McCoole here. No dates or places are given for the bouts.
